question: Should OpenClaw publish a public OpenAPI/Swagger contract for Gateway programmatic access, and should that contract be static, runtime-served, or intentionally replaced by a documented TypeBox/JSON Schema client-generation path?
rationale: This choice defines API coverage, auth visibility, plugin-route exposure, versioning, and upgrade compatibility, which should not be selected by cleanup automation.

options.title: Design Public Schema Contract First
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers define schema format, exposure path, covered APIs, auth/security boundaries, and versioning rules.

options.title: Publish Static Artifact Only
options.body: Add a versioned schema artifact for client generation without adding a runtime endpoint until auth and plugin-route disclosure are settled.

options.title: Use Existing Protocol Docs
options.body: Close later only if maintainers explicitly decide the TypeBox/JSON Schema and Gateway RPC docs are the supported client-generation surface.

recommendation.title: Design Public Schema Contract First
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers define schema format, exposure path, covered APIs, auth/security boundaries, and versioning rules.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest available history across the Gateway protocol, HTTP routing, docs, and client/protocol packaging surfaces.
